common_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: architectural interior design preview for client discussion, not a construction drawing.
Input image: Image 1 is the edit target, the existing residential entrance hall render. Use it as the exact spatial and camera template.
Primary request: make a single landscape, photorealistic architectural interior image, preserving this modest real residential hall rather than inventing a larger hotel lobby.
HARD INVARIANTS: preserve the original camera position, perspective, framing, room proportions, wall corners, floor plane, 3 m flat ceiling without a lowered ceiling, all doorway locations and opening dimensions, door swing arrangement and door count. Preserve the exact stroller position and its recognizable cream bassinet/black frame if present. Preserve all existing glass door frames, handles and glazing positions. No new openings, windows, niches, furniture, benches, plants, desks, decorative objects, people, mirrors or chandeliers. Do not enlarge or relocate walls. Add finish details only, thin and applied to the existing surfaces. Keep circulation completely clear.
Style: exceptionally convincing real architectural photography; level verticals, physically plausible contact shadows, restrained lens, fine surface microtexture, accurate seams, no overly smooth computer graphics. Gentle neutral white balance, naturally bright exposure, subdued warm 3000 K lighting rather than orange/yellow color cast. Keep the same positions and number of slim surface-mounted ceiling luminaires; refine their diffuser, metal edge and lighting quality. No cinematic darkness, bloom or exaggerated gloss.
Realism: visible but restrained matte paint texture, subtly variable tile faces, straight fine grout joints, tidy edge conditions and realistic material transitions. Keep the existing beige matte porcelain floor module and dark flat skirting unless the specific finish brief changes their tone.
Text: preserve existing functional navigation exactly as visible, including stroller symbol and "КОЛЯСОЧНАЯ" where present, and "ЛЕСТНИЦА", "ЛИФТ →", "1", "ЭТАЖ" only where already present in the source. Clear small architectural lettering, no extra words, captions, watermarks, presentation frames or invented project logo. The real brand logo is not supplied; leave its possible location unresolved rather than creating a fake logo.
Output: one single full-frame landscape image matching the source aspect ratio, no collage, no before/after, no text outside the scene.

items.title: Текущий вариант — колясочная
items.finish: Finish brief: improve the current accepted wood design without redesigning it. Retain the exact warm medium-brown vertical wood accent area and the gray-beige lower stroller wall protection panel, cream painted walls, dark graphite door frames/skirting and beige matte porcelain floor. Wood should be believable calm real oak/walnut decor, reduced orange saturation, restrained knots, fine open pores, subtle grain variation, clearly constructed broad vertical panels with very thin discreet joints. Preserve the area boundaries and relative widths of all wood finish elements, including the lift framing or wooden staircase door when present. Refine the gray protective lower panel as matte durable porcelain with microtexture, not shiny plastic. Improve glazing with faint physically plausible reflection/transparency and realistic gasket details, keep geometry unchanged. No brass accents in this baseline. The result should look like the SAME design properly photographed and detailed.
